cc:Work.dc:description: Replay of the existing bounded sensitivity diagnostic: five pressures, four temperatures and three velocities. The Li-derived proxy velocity-density regressions remain fixed; no regression is rerun. Temperature error bars are the audit's one-sigma conversion of the printed two-sigma widths. Model markers retain each measured shock state. This is a qualified proxy-model comparison, not recovery of Luo's unavailable global input set, Kono regressions or calibration covariance.
